## Validation

Primary metrics: dollar MAE and median absolute error. Secondary metrics: RMSLE, \(R^2\) on log-price, 80%/95% interval coverage, and interval width. Report metrics overall and by hull type, region, length band, age band, and seen versus unseen make–variant. Never select a model using test folds.

## Sensitivity and Robustness

Vary duplicate policy, rare-category threshold, spline complexity, loss function, extreme-price treatment, geographic granularity, and grouped versus ordinary splits. Bootstrap outer-fold differences between models. Check residual drift across price, age, and length. Treat rankings as unstable if model preference changes materially across reasonable specifications.

## Falsification

Reject or qualify the model if it fails the hull-median baseline, intervals undercover, residuals retain strong age/length structure, performance collapses on unseen designs, geographic effects reverse under minor cleaning changes, or predicted price decreases implausibly with length across broad supported ranges without data evidence.

## Reviewer Risks

Asking-price selection bias; omitted condition, equipment, seller, and exact listing-date variables; sparse variants; duplicate advertisements; geographic confounding; extrapolation outside 36–56 ft or sampled regions; target leakage through data-driven cleaning; metric mismatch from optimizing log error while claiming dollar accuracy; and overinterpreting associations as causal effects.
